verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents the full plumbing merchants would need for agent-initiated purchases—card enrollment, passkey-anchored consent, mandate/spend-limit controls, scoped credential retrieval, and the Trusted Agent Protocol for merchant-side verification—plus an MCP server for developers to wire agents into these APIs. However, the evidence pack lacks first-party confirmation of live integrations inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot specifically; the only signal referencing a named assistant is an oblique community comment about 'Visa plugs its payment network into ChatGPT,' which is not a documented, verifiable capability description. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statements or docs confirming checkout flows live inside ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Copilot surfaces, and independent hands-on confirmation that a purchase actually completed through one of these assistants.
